question:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Some depended on small donations, others on the **__benevolence__** of wealthy patrons.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"benevolence"** means the quality of being well-meaning; kindness. (दयालुता)

 
 
• **Example:** The **benevolence **of the volunteers made a significant difference in the lives of the refugees.
 
 
 
• **"Kindness"** refers to the quality of being friendly, generous, and considerate. (दयालुता)
 
 
• **Example:** Her **kindness** towards the homeless was evident in the way she provided them with food and shelter.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **'benevolence'** is **'kindness'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Divinity** (दिव्यता): The state of being divine or god-like.

 
 
• **Example:** The ancient temple was a place of divinity and worship.
 
 
 
• **Harshness** (कठोरता): The quality of being unpleasantly rough or severe.
 
 
• **Example:** The harshness of his words hurt her feelings.
 
 
 
• **Cruelty** (क्रूरता): Callous indifference to or pleasure in causing pain and suffering.
 
 
• **Example:** The cruelty shown to animals in the circus was unacceptable.
